Thanks for putting this together — it's clearly laid out and a lot of it matches what I picture. A few things stand out that I'd want changed before I'm comfortable signing off, and they're all inside the parts you're already covering (saving, searching, tagging).

1. **Saving a link should do more of the work for me.** Right now it says I have to type in the title myself, and it explicitly says the app won't look anything up. That's not what I want. When I paste a web address, I'd expect the app to go grab the page's title (and ideally a short description and the little site icon) and fill those in for me, so I can just tweak them if needed rather than typing everything by hand. Being able to save with almost nothing but the link is a big part of why I'd use this.

2. **Searching needs to be smarter than plain word matching.** A couple of things I'd expect: I want to be able to search my tags directly (something like typing `#recipes` to pull up everything tagged that way), and I want to combine terms — like "this AND that," "one OR the other," "this but NOT that," and putting quotes around a phrase to match it exactly. When my collection gets big, plain partial matching won't be enough to find things.

3. **Tag suggestions while I type.** When I'm adding a tag to a bookmark, I'd want it to suggest tags I've already used so I don't accidentally make three slightly different versions of the same tag.

4. **A "read it later" idea, not just favorites.** Favorites are fine, but the thing I really care about is marking a link as something I still need to read, and then being able to look at just those unread ones on their own. Favoriting my best links and tracking what I haven't gotten to yet feel like two different needs to me.

Everything else — accounts, sharing, syncing, folders, imports, and browser add-ons being left out for now — I'm okay with for a first version. Could you fold these four changes in and show me the updated version?
